observations.body: Coworkers, exchanged letters, Archippus, and Paul’s autograph. Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (about whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”), I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

payload.tension: The passage states coworkers, exchanged letters, Archippus, and Paul’s autograph. Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (about whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”), I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
